name: Village Square
description: The open heart of the village. At night, lit only by a single lamp post near the clinic. Silent except for the fountain.

name: Village Fountain
description: The old stone fountain in the centre of the square. The stone coping is crumbling in places — a loose piece is missing from the east rim.

name: The Mallet & Crown
description: The village pub, on the west side of the square. Closes at eleven on weeknights.

name: Owen Price's House & Yard
description: Owen's house on the corner of the square, timber yard behind. Gate faces the square.

name: Village Clinic
description: The small clinic. Nadia's flat is above it — her living room faces the square.

name: Elias's Cottage
description: Elias's cottage on the square's south side. His bedroom window faces the fountain.

name: Priya's Flat
description: Priya's flat two streets from the square.

name: Ben's Flat
description: Ben's small flat above the newsagent, one street from the square.
